title: Most Airports Touch One Route
subtitle: Undirected degree of the 1,909 airports in the sampled network, binned

rows.detail: Isolates: airports whose only sampled flights start and end at the same airport, so simplify() leaves them with no routes
The busiest is KORD with degree 74

caption: 1,523 of 1,909 airports (79.8%) have degree 2 or less. 526 of the 3,297 usable rows are same-airport flights (origin equals destination), and the 148 degree-0 airports are exactly the airports that only appear in such rows.
source: results/degree_bins.R and results/isolates.R (igraph 2.2.1) on the 5,065-row sample, and results/run.out
